Subject: Vendor onboarding follow-up: instructions and verification options

Hi Ellis — following up with a couple of verification options so you can choose what works best:

Option A — Micro-deposit verification (preferred):
- We will initiate two small micro-deposits to the account you list on the ACH form.
- Please confirm the amounts once you receive them and reply to this thread.
- Once validated, we mark the account active.

Option B — Bank letter or voided check (if you prefer not to share account numbers over email):
- A bank letter on letterhead confirming account ownership + last four digits is acceptable.
- We can accept the bank letter uploaded to DocuSign or attached to an email from your treasury domain (treasury@orridge.com).

PO and timing notes:
- Procurement will request a PO once the SOW is signed. The PO number is required on the invoice for automatic matching.
- Typical timeline: 3–5 business days after verification for the first payment to be scheduled (depends on payment run).

If you'd like I can start the enrollment in our AP system as soon as we receive the completed form.

Best,
Monica
